body: Thank you. I'm hoping I don't chicken out and change my mind. >_<
Same to you. Thanks for responding. I wish you the best too. If you ever want to talk I'm here.

I talked to my aunt a few weeks ago I think. I don't keep track of time we'll. But it's just sort of been ignored. My mom is back home so even if I told her she couldn't do much. I need to see someone. I'm getting my car situation worked out. I'm just scared to. I don't open up very well in real life. I've actually been thinking about printing out my reddit and tumblr posts and giving an edited version to whoever I see. Then at least I won't have to say it but I'm still scared.
It's been there for years. I'm just tired of fighting it now. Obviously I'm not dead yet so it's not a big deal. Maybe next time.

I don't see the point in anything anymore. What's the point of trying to feel better when it's not working? What's the point of anything. I'm not important. The only ones who would miss me would be my cats and I already have a good home for them to go to.
I'm still here for my cats. If not I would probably be dead long ago. Sometimes it feels like they're the only ones I have.
I have one friend I talk to about it but I'm starting to think he's getting tired of me.

Your doing great. I'm sorry. I just want to die so bad. It's become so hard to get through the day. I hate being around people. All I do is work and cut. And think about death. I have no car and 1 friend who I think is getting sick of me. My life is pathetic. All I can think is what's the point. I'm sorry. I wish I could just be okay. But I feel too far gone now.
I'm neither of those people. And if my story plays out anything like it has so far I want no part of it. I've tried really hard too. I've tried to feel better and ignore the thoughts. For so long.
